# Ads

> Create ads in ChatGPT and measure website conversions with the Measurement Pixel, authentication, campaigns, product feeds, ad groups, ads, uploads, and insights.

Use this as a compact map of the Ads docs. Each page has a Markdown twin at `/ads/<slug>.md`.

## Documentation sets
- [Combined Ads docs](https://developers.openai.com/ads/llms-full.txt): Single-file Markdown export of the Ads docs.

## Account Management
- [Account Management](https://developers.openai.com/ads/account-management.md): Manage advertiser branding, account status, and spending limits.

## Api Overview
- [Overview](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-overview.md): Create and manage campaigns with the Advertiser API.

## Api Partner Setup
- [API Partner Setup](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-partner-setup.md): Configure client accounts, conversions, and campaigns with the Ads API.

## Api Quickstart
- [Quickstart](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-quickstart.md): Launch your first Ads API workflow

## Api Reference
- [Ad Account](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/ad-account.md): Manage account metadata and account-wide spending limits.
- [Ad Groups](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/ad-groups.md): Create, list, retrieve, update, and change ad group state.
- [Ads](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/ads.md): Create, list, retrieve, update, preview, and change ad state.
- [Authentication](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/authentication.md): Setting up bearer token authentication.
- [Campaigns](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/campaigns.md): Create, list, retrieve, update, and change campaign state.
- [Conversion Setup](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/conversion-setup.md): Create pixels, Conversions API keys, and event settings.
- [Files](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/files.md): Upload remote images or binary files and reuse the returned file ID in ad creatives.
- [Insights](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/insights.md): Retrieve aggregated insights data across ad accounts, campaigns, ad groups, and ads.

## Bidding And Budgets
- [Bidding & Budgets](https://developers.openai.com/ads/bidding-and-budgets.md): Choose campaign objectives, bid strategies, and spending limits.

## Bulk Api
- [Bulk API](https://developers.openai.com/ads/bulk-api.md): Create and update campaigns, ad groups, and ads in bulk.

## Campaign Management
- [Campaign Management](https://developers.openai.com/ads/campaign-management.md): Create, update, preview, and manage campaigns, ad groups, and ads.

## Campaign Targeting
- [Targeting](https://developers.openai.com/ads/campaign-targeting.md): Configure geographic, platform, and audience targeting and context hints.

## Conversion Optimized Campaigns
- [Conversion-Optimized Campaigns](https://developers.openai.com/ads/conversion-optimized-campaigns.md): Optimize campaigns toward a selected conversion event while paying per click.

## Conversion Tracking
- [Conversion Tracking](https://developers.openai.com/ads/conversion-tracking.md): Set up event sources, send conversions, and connect them to campaigns.

## Conversions Api
- [Conversions API](https://developers.openai.com/ads/conversions-api.md): Server-to-server conversion events.

## Custom Audiences
- [Custom Audiences](https://developers.openai.com/ads/custom-audiences.md): Create, update, and combine customer audiences for campaign targeting and bid adjustments.

## Delta Feeds
- [Delta Feeds API](https://developers.openai.com/ads/delta-feeds.md): Update product availability and prices without uploading your entire catalog.

## Image Tag
- [Image Tag](https://developers.openai.com/ads/image-tag.md): Send conversion events from HTML without JavaScript.

## Location Targeting
- [Location Targeting](https://developers.openai.com/ads/location-targeting.md): Target campaigns by country, region, or market.

## Measurement Pixel
- [Measurement Pixel](https://developers.openai.com/ads/measurement-pixel.md): Send conversion events from web pages.

## Multiple Pixels
- [Multiple Pixel IDs](https://developers.openai.com/ads/multiple-pixels.md): Send events to multiple pixels or target one specific pixel.

## Platform Targeting
- [Platform Targeting](https://developers.openai.com/ads/platform-targeting.md): Choose the ChatGPT apps and web browsers where your campaign can deliver.

## Product Feeds
- [Product Feeds](https://developers.openai.com/ads/product-feeds.md): Set up, update, and advertise a product catalog.

## Reporting
- [Reporting](https://developers.openai.com/ads/reporting.md): Retrieve delivery, cost, product, and attributed conversion metrics.

## Supported Events
- [Supported Events](https://developers.openai.com/ads/supported-events.md): Supported conversion events & data shapes.

## Troubleshooting
- [Troubleshooting](https://developers.openai.com/ads/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose serving issues, reviews, low delivery, and API errors.
